items.title: Attackers Hijack .gh, .sl, and .as Registries to Obtain Certificates for Google Domains
items.summary:
Attackers compromised three country-code top-level domains (ccTLDs) and obtained unauthorized HTTPS certificates for several Google domains, Google said on October 6.
